title: SG-7.5 · Runner unit tests pass with Git, provider and clock mocked
summary: Runner unit tests for lock held, timeout, retry limit, budget, approval gate and report all pass using only fakes
description: Context: backend/worker/internal/runner has tests for each area but TestRunCleanup currently fails because it runs with AutoPublish false, so the approval gate keeps the worktree. Desired behavior: every runner unit test passes, and the six areas (lock held, timeout, retry limit, budget, approval gate, report) are covered including edge paths, with Git (fakeTrees), provider (fakeAgent) and clock (injected now) mocked. Expected result: go test ./internal/runner is green. Why: it proves the execution engine without Git, Claude or real time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the runner package, When go test ./internal/runner runs, Then all tests pass
Given each of lock held, timeout, retry limit, budget, approval gate and report, When tests run, Then at least one test asserts its behavior using only fakes

in_scope: Runner unit tests and the stale TestRunCleanup expectation

technical_constraints: Go tests only; no network, no real Git, no real clock sleeps beyond 20ms timeouts
